patch_description: Hybrid composition of the two strongest prior programs (Gen 45: lag 0.27 / noise 0.82; Gen 46: smoothness 0.30 / false reversals 34). Stage 1: constant-velocity Kalman forward pass with volatility-adaptive R and 3σ innovation gating (from Gen 45), using linalg.solve-based RTS backward smoothing for stable low-noise level+slope states. Stage 2: multi-scale zero-phase Savitzky-Golay with three half-widths blended by soft Gaussian weights on local volatility centered at 20/50/80 percentiles (from Gen 46) — wide windows kill false reversals in volatile regions while narrow windows preserve responsiveness. Stage 3: novel sigmoid-gated slope-lead compensation driven by the RTS smoothed slope (low-noise derivative), where a smooth sigmoid gate (rather than a hard binary gate) blends the lead in proportion to the slope's statistical significance — restoring dynamics killed by double smoothing without manufacturing spurious reversals. Stage 4: end-aligned trim to sliding-window output length.
